desc: The Colt Heirloom 1911 Government is a limited-edition masterpiece, with only 300 units produced, combining timeless design and craftsmanship. Chambered in .45 ACP, this 1911 features a 5-inch barrel and a stunning High Polish Copper Penny finish. Paired with presentation-grade black Kirinite grips, this pistol is as much a collectors item as it is a functional firearm.
